surface_strategies.cards: bg-white border border-[#E5E5E5] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Sticky top navigation. Logo on left, 'Get a free consultation' primary button on right. Glassmorphism effect.

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: High-impact hero. Massive typography 'Professional Websites. Zero Upfront Cost.' Subtext explaining the $99/mo all-inclusive model. Include the 'hero_abstract_3d' image floating asymmetrically.

sections.name: Pricing Benchmark Infographic
sections.description: Visualizing typical costs ($2k-$25k) vs the IT Niche model. Use the 'infographic_abstract' image as a stylistic backdrop for a card.
sections.layout: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 (Bento layout, spanning varying rows and columns)

sections.name: What Drives Cost
sections.description: 5 minimalist cards for Custom Design, Development, SEO, Content, Hosting & Maintenance. Use Phosphor icons (light).

sections.name: The Pitch / Cost Comparison
sections.description: Inverted black section. High contrast. Showcasing 'Why pay $5,000 upfront when you can pay $0?' Large #e57119 typography for the price.
sections.layout: flex flex-col items-center text-center py-32 px-6

sections.name: Why Choose Us
sections.description: Trust points: SEO-ready, clean code, transparent pricing. Use the 'agency_workspace' image.

sections.name: CTA / Footer
sections.description: Final push. 'Invest in a Website That Works.' Large CTA button linking to itniche.com. Simple footer links.

hero_abstract_3d.description: Abstract 3D geometric composition with orange accents for hero section.

infographic_abstract.description: Abstract infographic elements for the pricing benchmark section.

agency_workspace.description: High-contrast modern workspace image for the 'Why Choose Us' section.

animations.framer_motion_defaults: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} viewport={{ once: true }} transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit'.
Implement the Bento Grid for the Pricing Benchmark section.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
For cards and bordered containers, use `p-8` or `p-12` instead of standard small padding.
Ensure high contrast: text must be clearly legible against backgrounds (use APCA standards).
The Hero CTA must say 'Get a free consultation' and link to https://www.itniche.com
